# The Origins {background-image="pictures/eoc_discount.jpg" background-opacity="0.75" background-position="center 62%"}

## Motivation: the EOC

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="46%"}
![Performing **Heavy Rotations** with the EOC.](pictures/eoc_cables_mixing.jpg){.photo .ph .maxh-400 fig-alt="EOC performance: a person at the mixing table with turntables, laptop and many cables, modular synthesizer players behind"}

::: {.smaller-text}
<sup>1</sup> [eo-charlottenburg.de](https://eo-charlottenburg.de/)
:::
:::
::: {.column width="54%"}
**Electronic Orchestra Charlottenburg**<sup>1</sup>

- Live electronics with 8–12 modular synths on immersive loudspeaker systems
- Fully analog connections 
- Digital mixer and processing
- Sound director mixes and spatializes everyone in real time

---

::: {.fragment}
**Motivation** 

- Move routing and mixing into the network
- Reduce audio cables and hardware
- Allow for enhanced interaction

:::
:::
::::

## SPRAWL I: Hub Mode

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
![SPRAWL's hub architecture.](pictures/SPRAWL-server-access-point-architecture.png){.photo .pair-img fig-alt="SPRAWL's hub architecture."}

* Hub server for mixing and rendering
* Access points for musicians
* JackTrip for audio routing
* Sound system connected to Hub

:::
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
![SPRAWL session with Chris.](pictures/sprawl_chris_2.jpg){.photo .pair-img fig-alt="Chris standing and gesturing in a room full of SPRAWL access points, laptops and cables"}

![Access point with wooden housing.](pictures/access_point.jpg){.photo .wide-img fig-alt="Close-up of two plywood access-point housings with a TU Studio logo and Ethernet cables"}
:::
::::
